exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you went to a concert or live performance.
Some people prefer to listen to music alone with headphones, while others prefer live music or listening with friends. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering cutting its music program to save money and focus more on math and science. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your neighborhood is proposing a rule that loud music and parties are not allowed after 9 p.m. on weekends. I am a member of the neighborhood association. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
